CI gate: fail if the API changed in a forbidden way

Source: R/check.R
check_api.Rd

Designed to be called in CI right after a release tag is created (or in a PR against the last release tag):

Usage

check_api(old, new, strict = FALSE, fail_on = "breaking")

Arguments

old, new

Snapshots or paths, as for compare_api().

strict

Treat behaviour-level changes (changed defaults) as breaking?

fail_on

Severities that should fail the check.

Value

Invisibly, the api_diff (when the check passes).

Details

Rscript -e 'apiGuard::check_api(apiGuard::api_snapshot_ref("v1.0.0"), ".")'

Exits non-zero (via stop()) when any change of a severity listed in fail_on is detected. The default matches suggest_version_bump(): behaviour-level changes (a changed default) recommend a minor bump and do not fail the gate. Pass strict = TRUE to treat them as breaking in both places.
